summary: Session 66 retest (frontend only) of the 4 fixes from iteration_39 plus full regression. (1) Image fix VERIFIED: all 12 Unsplash URLs in financialArticles.js return HTTP 200 via curl; in-browser naturalWidth=1600 for both home-financial-article-aktien-fuer-einsteiger (photo-1638913662180) and -anleihen-rendite-und-kurs (photo-1607944024060); 15/15 images in the section render (0 broken); no request for the old 404 id photo-1590283603385-c1c67c40d0d4. (2) Filter fix VERIFIED: etfs-fonds=1 card, aktien=2, zinsen=3, sparen=1, maerkte=1, finanzwissen=4, all=11 — every filter >=1 card and home-financial-articles-empty never rendered. (3) Related fix VERIFIED: finanzwissen-article-related present with exactly 3 related cards (+1 'Alle Artikel' link) on etfs-verstehen-worauf-anleger-achten-sollten, tagesgeld-oder-festgeld, was-anleger-ueber-inflation-wissen-sollten and aktien-fuer-einsteiger; no self-reference in related list. (4) Secondary stack now 3 teasers (secondary-0/1/2) and the teaser column stretches to the same flex height (800px) as the featured card, though content still ends ~140px above the featured card bottom. (5) Regression all green: BankingHero, HomeNewsPreview, HomeInvestmentSpectrum, bonus-cta-section present; 7/7 'Fragen beantworten' wizards open and close; CTA navigates to /wissen; invalid slug /finanzwissen/does-not-exist-xyz redirects to / ; exactly 1 h1 on /, /wissen, /handeln, /fonds-grundlagen and all detail pages; zero pageerrors on any route.

critical_code_review_comments: getRelatedFinancialArticles cross-category fallback is correct (excludes self, fills up to limit) — no issues found.

HomeFinancialArticles filter branch now uses FINANCIAL_ARTICLES for specific categories, so the featured article can appear both in the featured slot and in the grid for its own category (etfs-fonds). This is the intended fix but means duplicate rendering of the same article on one screen; acceptable, just noting the trade-off.
Filter state is still not reflected in the URL/hash (carried over from iteration_39) — filtered views cannot be shared or restored.
